== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (<code>1273_1</code>, Virtual Block 7 slip 79), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 7.3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-p2-79-5D6_RA_7_Fivedesix.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-5d6ra7-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]; the Master List (2013) reprints the original.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words (pilot icon, ▲, Immune to Alter) are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “[Pilot] 2. Power +1 while with your leader. If at a scomp link when opponent draws a destiny of: 1-3, you may activate one force; 4-6, you may draw top card of your reserve deck; 0 or 7 you may retrieve 1 force.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1273_1</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark, caption, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB7-p2-79-5D6_RA_7_Fivedesix-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B27 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
